rawContent: 13. And this of the saddest thing: Less than showing the power of mass protest to enact change, #BlackLivesMatter showed the power of BRANDING for the benefit of movement leaders—and for their ability to manipulate journalists & stymie direct action w cheap emotion & thru greed.

15. It’s awful that the legacy of #BlackLivesMatter is one of greedy leaders, learning how to manipulate media, suppressing real protest and casting aspersions on the actions of tens of millions of protesters. The mvmt was/is great; the branding is not. A shame they’re conflated.
